cycle_signal.rationale: 9 cycle length(s) derived (range 28-44d). Persistent >=7-day consecutive-cycle variability detected (STRAW+10 stage -2 marker).

evidence.assumption: Self-tracked bleeding history and symptom severity can be mapped onto STRAW+10 menstrual criteria for stages -3a through +2 within the system's stated applicability limits.
evidence.source: Harlow SD, Gass M, Hall JE, et al. Executive summary of the Stages of Reproductive Aging Workshop +10 (J Clin Endocrinol Metab 97:1159; Menopause 19:387; Climacteric 15:105; 2012)

evidence.assumption: Cycle-pair variability, amenorrhea-window measurement, and symptom-persistence thresholds conservatively reproduce STRAW+10 without claiming endocrine biomarker access.
evidence.source: Period backend perimenopause STRAW+10 staging analyzer v1

evidence_summary: 9 cycle(s) derived · 7 pair(s) >=7d variable · longest gap 44d · no major suppressors
recommended_actions: Early menopausal transition is suggested by >=7-day cycle variability; discuss symptom management options and bone/cardiovascular risk with a clinician.
Differential reminders: thyroid dysfunction, hyperprolactinemia, hypothalamic amenorrhea, Asherman syndrome, and endometrial pathology should be ruled out for unexplained changes in bleeding.
summary: Early menopausal transition: persistent >=7-day cycle-length variability detected.

symptom_signal.rationale: Symptom signals: none persistent in window
